name: apply_patch
description: Add, update, move and delete files with one patch. The patch starts with "*** Begin Patch" and ends with "*** End Patch". Between them, each file starts with "*** Add File: <path>", "*** Delete File: <path>" or "*** Update File: <path>". Every line of an added file starts with "+". An update may be followed by "*** Move to: <path>", then holds hunks that start with "@@" or "@@ <context line>" and whose lines start with " " (context), "-" (removed) or "+" (added). Files are changed in order and earlier changes stay when a later one fails.
guidance: Use apply_patch to change several files, or several places in one file, in one call.
